purpose: Tracks real physical user idle time by installing WH_KEYBOARD_LL and WH_MOUSE_LL hooks that ignore injected (automation) input; optionally counts XInput gamepad activity as user presence.
calls_out_to: kernel32!GetTickCount64 — monotonic timer for idle measurement
xinput1_4.dll / xinput9_1_0.dll / xinput1_3.dll — XInput gamepad state polling
invariants: _lastPhysicalInputMilliseconds is updated atomically via Interlocked on every genuine physical event
SuppressInjected and GamepadEnabled are volatile — writes from UI thread are immediately visible in hook/timer callbacks
Hook repair retries are rate-limited to once per 30 seconds
gotchas: GetIdleMilliseconds returns the SMALLER of hook-based idle and system idle (GetLastInputInfo) when UseSystemIdleFailSafe is true — this prevents the app from launching when the OS sees recent activity that hooks may have missed
XInput fallback tries xinput1_4 → xinput9_1_0 → xinput1_3 at runtime; sets _xinput=None if all are absent so future calls are cheap no-ops
Gamepad deadzone comparison uses squared magnitude to avoid sqrt; thresholds match Microsoft XInput.h defaults
Hooks run in a global Windows hook context — any exception inside the callback is caught, logged once, and the hook continues in a degraded state rather than crashing
